item.title: About
item.description: Lucid Vagary is a home for image-poems and poetry — where creativity inspires insight.

item.title: The City
item.description: Written at Miller Park, near Gary, Indiana — the site of the author’s hemorrhagic stroke. The city, a world of constant activity, Finds its cohesion in the cacophony. But this hostel, on a numinous road, Gives the illusion of floating on water. A sharp spire rises, a monolithic golem, A silent giant born of steel and loam. A Leviathan stands guard among the two Tallest rivals, piercing the hazy blue. And who maintains this fragile stage?
